403: section PseudoMetricSpace
404: variable [PseudoMetricSpace α]
405: 
406: /-- The diameter of a set in a metric space. To get controllable behavior even when the diameter
407: should be infinite, we express it in terms of the `ediam` -/
408: noncomputable def diam (s : Set α) : ℝ :=
409:   ENNReal.toReal (ediam s)
410: 
411: /-- The diameter of a set is always nonnegative -/
412: theorem diam_nonneg : 0 ≤ diam s :=
413:   ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
414: 
415: theorem diam_subsingleton (hs : s.Subsingleton) : diam s = 0 := by
416:   simp [diam, ediam_subsingleton hs]
417: 
418: /-- The empty set has zero diameter -/
419: @[simp]
420: theorem diam_empty : diam (∅ : Set α) = 0 :=
421:   diam_subsingleton subsingleton_empty
422: 
423: /-- A singleton has zero diameter -/
424: @[simp]
425: theorem diam_singleton : diam ({x} : Set α) = 0 :=
426:   diam_subsingleton subsingleton_singleton
427: 
428: @[to_additive (attr := simp)]
429: theorem diam_one [One α] : diam (1 : Set α) = 0 :=
430:   diam_singleton
431: 
432: -- Does not work as a simp-lemma, since {x, y} reduces to (insert y {x})
433: theorem diam_pair : diam ({x, y} : Set α) = dist x y := by
434:   simp only [diam, ediam_pair, dist_edist]
435: 
436: -- Does not work as a simp-lemma, since {x, y, z} reduces to (insert z (insert y {x}))
437: theorem diam_triple :
438:     diam ({x, y, z} : Set α) = max (max (dist x y) (dist x z)) (dist y z) := by
439:   simp only [diam, ediam_triple, dist_edist]
